1.Title: Sleepless Eternal Night
1.Description: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>. DMG dealt ignores <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color>. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color>, and DMG dealt by all other squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of the DMG increase effect can exist in the same squad.
